entities.summary: Tyler Bertuzzi is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a left winger and alternate captain for the Chicago Blackhawks of the National Hockey League (NHL). Bertuzzi was drafted 58th overall by the Detroit Red Wings in the 2013 NHL entry draft. He has also previously played for the Boston Bruins and Toronto Maple Leafs.
